title.narrative: Jiangxi Sustainable Forest Ecosystem Development Project

description.narrative: The project will involve 23 counties in Jiangxi province. The project comprises four components: (i) sustainable forest plantation development and rehabilitation in about 50,900 hectares (ha) of barren and low-yield forestland, (ii) forest insurance and awareness-raising measures to mitigate natural disaster risks for forest development, (iii) capacity development for sustainable forest management, and (iv) project management support.

Loan 2694: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022

Status of Implementation Progress: As of last review mission in 2017, the project developed 29,383 ha of timber plantation and 4,886 ha of economic tree crops, and restored 11,639 ha of low-yield and stormed-damaged bamboo forests. A total of 29,383 ha of timber plantation are insured against natural risks. Training workshops have been organized at provincial and county levels on project implementation, financial management, technical guidelines, forest insurance, pest control and fire prevention measures, environmental safeguards, and disbursement.
The project was physically completed on 31 October 2017.
